idea-plugin.name: EWP Project Sync
idea-plugin.description:
Keep IAR EWARM *.ewp project files in sync with CLion.

Features

  • Synchronize project files: Automatically update ewp project files when source files are added, deleted, or moved.
  • Ensure correct sorting of project files: Use "Reformat" on ewp files to match EWARM's file ordering.
  • Edit project files: Add, remove, or move files between ewp groups in the EWP Explorer.
  • Remove missing files: Find files no longer on disk and remove them from the ewp with a quick fix.

What this plugin is not

This plugin does not load or build projects from ewp files. Load your project in CLion using a supported method, such as CMake or a compilation database.

Legal Notice

This is an unofficial plugin that supports working with ewp files created by IAR Embedded Workbench for Arm (EWARM). It is not affiliated with IAR Systems.
